title: Mesh light matrices UBO + runtime controls (light view/proj)
purpose: Provide a consistent directional light with view/projection to support a light-space transmittance map used for particle self-shadowing.

steps.detail: Create LightUBO { mat4 lightView; mat4 lightProj; vec3 lightDir; float intensity; } and allocate a descriptor for the mesh path.
Compute tight orthographic light matrices covering the particle cloud AABB. Update each frame or on-demand when bounds change.
Add runtime controls to yaw/pitch lightDir and adjust ortho extents; print values throttled to logs.
Bind UBO to the mesh fragment shader set and consume lightDir for baseline Lambert shading (kept simple).

acceptance: Light matrices logged; light frustum visually matches particle cloud extent
Mesh fragment uses lightDir for a simple Lambert term
notes: Keep UBO small and updated alongside existing push constants; avoid conflicts with current descriptor set layout by allocating a new binding if needed.
